description: This file contains localization strings for the Select2 plugin, specifically the Indonesian language translations for error messages and prompts.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message when loading data fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message when input is below minimum length.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message while loading more data.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message when maximum selection limit is reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.
